selection.rule: Homepage events come from current RSS/advisory sources. CVEs are shown only when the source article/advisory mentions them.

items.title: Japan's Keio confirms ransomware attack disrupted business systems
items.summary: Keio Corporation (Keio), a major private railway operator in Japan, said its network was hit by a ransomware attack over the weekend, disrupting some of its business systems. [...]
items.title_zh: 日本京王電鐵確認勒索軟體攻擊導致業務系統中斷
items.summary_zh: 日本大型私鐵業者京王電鐵（Keio）表示，其網路在週末遭到勒索軟體攻擊，導致部分業務系統中斷。[...]

items.title: JadePuffer agentic AI attacks target Azure, destroy cloud resources
items.summary: The JadePuffer ransomware operator is targeting Azure tenants with agent-driven attacks that conduct reconnaissance, steal credentials, and destroy core components. [...]
items.title_zh: JadePuffer 代理型 AI 攻擊針對 Azure 並摧毀雲端資源
items.summary_zh: JadePuffer 勒索軟體營運者正透過代理驅動（agent-driven）的攻擊針對 Azure 租戶，進行偵察、竊取憑證並摧毀核心組件。[...]

items.title: Apple Patches Meta-Reported Zero-Day Linked to ‘Extremely Sophisticated Attack’
items.summary: Apple has released iOS and macOS updates to patch the zero-day vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-86950. The post Apple Patches Meta-Reported Zero-Day Linked to ‘Extremely Sophisticated Attack’ appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Apple 修補 Meta 通報且與「極度複雜攻擊」相關的零日漏洞
items.summary_zh: Apple 已釋出 iOS 與 macOS 更新，以修補追蹤為 CVE-2026-86950 的零日漏洞。這篇《Apple Patches Meta-Reported Zero-Day Linked to ‘Extremely Sophisticated Attack’》文章首次出現於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Citrix Confirms 2 NetScaler Zero-Days After Admins Pulled the Plug
items.summary: Citrix has released patches for the critical NetScaler vulnerabilities tracked as CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772. The post Citrix Confirms 2 NetScaler Zero-Days After Admins Pulled the Plug appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 管理員拔除電源後 Citrix 確認 2 個 NetScaler 零日漏洞
items.summary_zh: Citrix 已針對追蹤為 CVE-2026-88771 和 CVE-2026-88772 的關鍵 NetScaler 漏洞釋出修補程式。這篇《Citrix Confirms 2 NetScaler Zero-Days After Admins Pulled the Plug》文章首次出現於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Citrix confirms two NetScaler RCE zero-days exploited in attacks
items.summary: Citrix has confirmed that two critical NetScaler remote code execution vulnerabilities, tracked as CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772, are being exploited in attacks and that it has released security updates to fix the flaws. [...]

items.summary_zh: Citrix 已證實追蹤為 CVE-2026-88771 與 CVE-2026-88772 的兩項嚴重 NetScaler 遠端執行程式碼漏洞正於攻擊中遭利用，且已發布安全更新以修復這些缺陷。[...]
